decisions.default_route: Retain ai-berkshire at fd83d06 as provenance-only MIT method source, consume its existing reader overlay through safe typed profiles for the single DeepSeek provider behind the existing LLM Port, use Tavily only for current-run gap discovery behind the existing vendor-neutral Port with bounded stateless credential failover, and render deterministic server-compiled Markdown with exact react-markdown and remark-gfm versions. Historical replay never calls live discovery; DeepSeek supplies evidence-rubric judgments and Chinese explanations while project code validates complete evidence scope, PIT and every published score. R2 recovery reuses the same LLM Port for semantic support assessment with exact fact/excerpt bindings; deterministic reader compilation replaces the separate reader-generation call. Existing PostgreSQL transactions persist one fenced checkpoint and coordinate deployment-wide provider permits; Celery/outbox remains the queue. No new dependency or orchestration framework. Synthetic v4 scenarios use the same score assessment with explicit scenario basis, coefficient one and zero real-source confidence; optional scorecard and reader reuse available_result and the existing checkpoint without new services or tables. The approved 2026-09-08 real preview starts empty, reuses Flash for planning and extraction and a separate Pro call for source-text audit before the existing three report calls. pypdf 6.18.0 supplies bounded text-only PDF extraction in the existing governed adapter; checkpoint 1.3 retains candidates, verdicts and per-gap attempts. Synthetic fixtures remain offline and historical artifacts retain their versions. The 2026-09-11 repair uses the existing SourceDiscoveryPort with a code-bound CNINFO public annual-report index for initial real identity/business acquisition; Tavily remains the bounded directed fallback. Reuse governed HTTPS/DNS/robots/body/deadline checks, never supply facts from index metadata, add no dependency and do not unlock the historical R1 runner. The approved 2026-09-14 reliability repair reuses the existing checkpoint JSONB for immutable original observations and offset windows, and stable narrative-slot patches with pending-only re-audit. LlamaIndex document identity/cache, Unstructured original element provenance and LangGraph checkpoint persistence are design references only; no library, vector store or second executor is adopted. Evidence of project benefit is limited to fixed regressions until same-version real acceptance completes.
